Memberships.metaTitle: Memberships | Cluster of Startups and Innovation (CSI)
Memberships.metaDescription: Learn about the maker and company membership levels of the Cluster of Startups and Innovation in Puebla, and how to apply.

hero.title: A place for makers, startups and companies building in Puebla
hero.description: Joining the cluster means having a workspace, a network of people and institutions, and visibility within the state's innovation ecosystem.
hero.imageAlt: Makers working in a shared space at the Innovation Hub

why.title: Why join the cluster
why.description: Membership opens three concrete things for those who are part of the community.

items.title: Hub access
items.description: Workspaces and laboratories at CERHAN II, alongside communities that share knowledge and tools every day.

items.title: Real connections
items.description: Direct links with government, academia and industry, plus makers and startups building in Puebla.

items.title: Visibility
items.description: Presence in cluster events, programs and announcements, so your work is visible to the whole ecosystem.

levels.title: Two paths, eleven levels
levels.description: Membership is organized into two groups: M levels for makers and community, and E levels for companies. Each level describes who it applies to; contribution amounts are shared during the application process.
levels.makersNote: For individuals, students and projects in development.
levels.companiesNote: For organizations that want to engage with the ecosystem.

makers.name: Explorer
makers.description: People curious about tech entrepreneurship; they access open events and information sessions.

makers.name: Base maker
makers.description: Students and enthusiasts starting to take part in Hub life.

makers.name: Active maker
makers.description: Those who attend regularly, share tools and collaborate in community activities.

makers.name: Maker with a project
makers.description: People with an idea or prototype in development seeking feedback and support.

makers.name: Maker with a team
makers.description: Groups of two or more people working on a shared project at the Hub.

makers.name: Validated prototype
makers.description: Projects with evidence of real use, early users or technical validation.

makers.name: Startup in formation
makers.description: Teams in pre-incubation structuring their business model within the cluster.

makers.name: Established startup
makers.description: Startups already operating in the market and giving back to the community.

companies.name: Allied company
companies.description: Organizations that want to connect with the maker community and take part in cluster events.

companies.name: Collaborating company
companies.description: Companies that join challenges, programs and laboratories together with makers and startups.

companies.name: Founding partner company
companies.description: Organizations that support the cluster's strategic direction and co-invest in the ecosystem.

apply.title: How to apply
apply.description: The process is simple and personal; no application goes unanswered.

steps.title: Send your interest
steps.description: Write to us from the contact page and tell us who you are: maker, project or company.

steps.title: We talk
steps.description: We schedule a Hub visit or a video call to learn about your proposal and suggest the level that fits you best.

steps.title: Formalize your membership
steps.description: You receive the level sheet with current contributions and confirm your incorporation.

steps.title: Join the community
steps.description: You get your welcome, Hub access and the activity calendar for your level.
